caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet as the central object, with the main portion shown in a three-quarters view. The bonnet has a woven, straw-colored structure forming the upper and rear parts, while the brim is made of a dark gray material that curves downward and outward from the face opening. Two long, gray ribbon ties hang from either side of the bonnet and drape loosely downward. The inner lining along the rim of the bonnet appears gray, matching the brim and ties. On the right side of the drawing, there are two sketched outlines showing the bonnet from the back and side views, rendered simply in pencil without color or shading. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or detailing.
title: Bonnet
